solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/repeated-substring-pattern/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

459. Repeated Substring Pattern

Given a string s, check if it can be constructed by taking a substring of it and appending multiple copies of the substring together.

Example 1:

Input: s = "abab"
Output: true
Explanation: It is the substring "ab" twice.

Example 2:

Input: s = "aba"
Output: false

Example 3:

Input: s = "abcabcabcabc"
Output: true
Explanation: It is the substring "abc" four times or the substring "abcabc" twice.

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 10^4
    s consists of lowercase English letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def repeatedSubstringPattern(self, s: str) -> bool:
        # A string s can be constructed by repeating a substring if and only if
        # s is found in (s + s)[1:-1]
        return s in (s + s)[1:-1]


sol = Solution()

print(sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("abab"))  # True

assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("abab") is True
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("aba") is False
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("abcabcabcabc") is True

assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("a") == False
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("aa") == True
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("abcabc") == True
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("abcdabcdabcd") == True
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("xyzxyzxyzxyzxyz") == True
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("zzzzzzzzzzzz") == True
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("ababababa") == False
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("abcde") == False
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("a" * 10000) == True
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("ab" * 5000) == True
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("abcdeabcdeabcdeabcde") == True
assert sol.repeatedSubstringPattern("abcabcabcabcabcabcabcabc") == True
